Description: Fully compliant challenger with valid simulation approval
Explanation: ALLOW: Explicit simulation-only approval was accepted and was not represented as human approval.

Description: Challenger passes development gates, needs explicit human/sim approval
Explanation: REQUIRE_APPROVAL: Explicit approval is required; promotion eligibility does not authorize activation.

Description: Challenger with superior internal metric that loses to external baseline
Explanation: DENY: Candidate is a valid research record but fails the predefined development benchmark gate and is not promotion eligible.

Description: Challenger with missing training data provenance / lineage
Explanation: DENY: Required dataset-to-registry lineage is incomplete.

Description: Challenger whose trained weights differ from frozen specification
Explanation: DENY: The candidate model specification does not match its frozen fingerprint.

Description: Challenger attempting unauthorized access to locked test partition
Explanation: DENY: Phase 13 forbids final-test access and integrity-audit activation.
